name: simplex
title: SimpleX
concern: SimpleX messaging through the forwarding bridge: reading incoming messages, sending messages to contacts, and showing the user's contact link.

categories.simplex: SimpleX messaging: reading incoming messages, sending messages to contacts, and showing the user's contact link.

enabled.doc: Load this pack's skills and run its bridge.

token.doc: Shared secret required in the X-Semif-Token header when set.

max_inbox.doc: Bound on the in-memory inbound-message buffer.

ws_url.doc: The bridge's OWN simplex-chat daemon WebSocket URL (must match simplex_chat.forward_port).

user_id.doc: Daemon user id the bridge acts as.
